import tkinter as tk
import threading
import pystray
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

def create_icon\(\):
    img = Image.new\('RGBA', \(64, 64\), \(0, 0, 0, 0\)\)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw\(img\)
    draw.rectangle\([6, 8, 58, 44], fill='blue'\)
    return img

root = tk.Tk\(\)
root.title\('Test Tray'\)
root.geometry\('200x100'\)

def minimize\(\):
    root.withdraw\(\)
    icon = pystray.Icon\('test', create_icon\(\), 'Test', menu=pystray.Menu\(
        pystray.MenuItem\('Abrir', lambda i, item: \(root.after\(0, root.deiconify\), i.stop\(\)\)\),
        pystray.MenuItem\('Salir', lambda i, item: \(i.stop\(\), root.after\(0, root.destroy\)\)\),
    \)\)
    threading.Thread\(target=icon.run, daemon=True\).start\(\)

root.protocol\('WM_DELETE_WINDOW', minimize\)
print\('Window created, close it to test tray...'\)
root.mainloop\(\)
print\('Done'\)
